item.title: Same license plate, different cars: Suburban driver fights red light ticket

item.title: Chicago weather: Heavy lake-effect snow Friday, Saturday; winter weather advisories issued
item.description: Heavy lake effect snow will develop Friday and Saturday, leading to quickly changing road conditions and dangerous travel at times.Tonight will be quiet with clear skies becoming partly cloudy with lows in the lower single digits. item.description: A new report says your utility bills have become the fastest driver of inflation, according to Powerlines.The nonpartisan consumer education nonprofit PowerLines researched utility bills and the state of energy affordability. item.title: Atlanta Falcons hire Ian Cunningham, Chicago Bears assistant GM & Ryan Poles right-hand man
item.description: Ryan Poles' top assistant is finally getting his shot as a general manager in the NFL.Chicago Bears' assistant general manager Ian Cunningham has been hired as the Atlanta Falcons general manager, the Falcons announced Thursday evening.Cunningham interviewed for the Falcons' general manager opening twice. The first interview was on Jan. 23, and the second interview was Thursday.The Falcons made their decision quickly after the second interview, hiring Cunningham to join a new-look Falcons team."

item.title: House explosion reported in Oswego, officials say
item.description: A house explosion was reported Thursday night in Oswego, prompting a large emergency response, authorities said.The explosion occurred around 6 p.m. in the 200 block of Fox Chase Drive North.According to Oswego police, they believe a gas leak led to the explosion. Details on what happened or whether anyone was injured haven't been released. Nicor Gas crews are also on scene conducting a preliminary investigation.This is a developing story and we'll bring more updates as they become available.
